prompt: Mike, an IT security specialist, wants to ensure that a specific user, `alison`, cannot access the system via SSH. Besides using the `DenyUsers` directive, which other directive can he use to achieve this by specifying a list of users who are allowed to access?
explanation: The `AllowUsers` directive in the `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` file provides a whitespace-separated list of user names that are allowed to log in. Any user not in this list will be denied SSH access. By setting this directive and omitting `alison` from the list, Mike can prevent her from accessing the system via SSH.
